refused_program.body:
set -eu
up="{upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch}"
git fetch {upstream_remote} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
git merge --no-edit "$up" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD "$up")
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U > "$tmp/conflicted" || true
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  git show "$up:$f" > "$tmp/theirs" 2>/dev/null || : > "$tmp/theirs"
  git diff -U3 --no-color "$mb" HEAD -- "$f" > "$tmp/local.diff" || true
  awk '
    /^@@/ { inhunk = 1; pend = 0; n = 0; next }
    !inhunk { next }
    /^---/ { next }
    /^-/ { pend++; next }
    /^\+/ { if (pend > 0) { pend--; next } p[n++] = substr($0, 2); next }
    /^ / { if (n > 0) { c = substr($0, 2); for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { print c; print p[i] } n = 0 } pend = 0; next }
    END { if (n > 0) { for (i = 0; i < n; i++) { print ""; print p[i] } } }
  ' "$tmp/local.diff" > "$tmp/pairs"
  : > "$tmp/filtered"
  while IFS= read -r anchor; do
    IFS= read -r text || break
    if grep -F -x -q -- "$text" "$tmp/theirs"; then continue; fi
    printf '%s\n' "$anchor" >> "$tmp/filtered"
    printf '%s\n' "$text" >> "$tmp/filtered"
  done < "$tmp/pairs"
  awk -v rules="$tmp/filtered" '
    BEGIN { na = 0; while ((getline a < rules) > 0) { if ((getline t < rules) <= 0) break; anc[na] = a; txt[na] = t; na++ } }
    { for (j = 0; j < na; j++) if (!done[j] && anc[j] != "" && anc[j] == $0) { print txt[j]; done[j] = 1 } print }
    END { for (j = 0; j < na; j++) if (!done[j]) print txt[j] }
  ' "$tmp/theirs" > "$tmp/resolved"
  cp "$tmp/resolved" "$f"
  git add -- "$f"
done < "$tmp/conflicted"
if git rev-parse -q --verify MERGE_HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git commit --no-edit >/dev/null
fi
rm -rf "$tmp"
